name: Naltrexone
description: A competitive opioid receptor antagonist approved for alcohol use disorder and for opioid use disorder after detoxification. Low-dose off-label use at 1 to 4.5 mg for inflammatory and pain conditions rests on a distinct and much thinner evidence base.

systems.note: Opioid receptor antagonism reducing reward signalling; the labelled indication.
Hepatotoxicity carried a boxed warning historically; transaminase elevation remains labelled.

monitors.why: Labelled transaminase elevation; the boxed hepatic warning was only removed after further data.
